slides.title: Untangling holiday lights for an hour every year? Finds that end it.
A light storage reel
slides.body: Wind the lights on as they come down. Next year they unroll in one pull.

slides.title: Ornament boxes with dividers
slides.body: One slot per ornament. Nothing breaks, nothing gets lost.

slides.title: A clear lidded bin
slides.body: See the decor without opening it. Clear beats labelled for our brains.

slides.title: A wreath storage bag
slides.body: Keeps it round and dust-free. Hangs on a closet hook.

slides.title: Bright tape labels
slides.body: 'Tree lights' or 'outside.' Big words you can read from across the garage.

slides.title: The best time to make next year easy is the day you take it down.
Get the decor storage finds list
